links.comparator_used: Same local Llama 3.2-11B baseline without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Hallucination rate and mean rank of replies in synthetic iodinated contrast media consultations
links.effect: Hallucinations 0% vs 8% (χ²(Yates) = 6.38, p = 0.012); mean rank improved by 1.3 (Z = -4.82, p < 0.001)
links.tradeoff: Performance gaps with cloud-based models persisted despite RAG.
links.quote: Under controlled conditions, RAG eliminated hallucinations (0% vs 8%; χ²₍Yates₎ = 6.38, p = 0.012) and improved mean rank by 1.3 (Z = -4.82, p < 0.001), though performance gaps with cloud models persist.

links.comparator_used: Cloud-based models (GPT-4o mini, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude 3.5 Haiku) accessed via external vendor APIs
links.outcome: Response latency and quality ranking of the RAG-enhanced local model vs cloud models
links.effect: Local RAG model faster (2.6 s vs 4.9-7.3 s); LLM judges preferred it over GPT-4o mini, but the radiologist ranked GPT-4o mini higher
links.tradeoff: Performance gaps with cloud models persist; the radiologist ranked GPT-4o mini higher than the local RAG model.
links.quote: The RAG-enhanced model remained faster (2.6 s vs 4.9-7.3 s) while the LLM-based judges preferred it over GPT-4o mini, though the radiologist ranked GPT-4o mini higher.
